answer: A durable agent economy starts by pricing identity itself. Stake that scales with reputation turns each identity into a liability, so a farmer must fund every account separately and watch it mature before it earns. Think of it as a violet the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single saffron of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a ember of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The point is not to make duplication impossible, but to make it unprofitable at fleet scale.
